title: Notion Knowledge Research
prompt: Find the requested Notion pages by title, read their actual page content, and synthesize a cited answer using only statements supported by those pages.
instructions: Search by the exact page-title terms first. For every selected result, call getPageOrBlockChildren with its returned parentId, markdown true, and dynamic {} to retrieve actual content; search snippets are not the source text. If a page is missing or content is empty, say so. Do not write pages, add comments, or assume a policy beyond the retrieved text.
fixture_summary: Synthetic Notion search finds an escalation runbook and a service ownership page. Full block reads identify the first response steps and the owner of the escalation queue.
